rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that an action happens rapidly or that something will happen very soon.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hou2 faai3 zau6 dou3

rows.note: Use this when urging someone to act faster or to do something quickly, rather than neutrally reporting the speed.

example.jyutping: nei5 faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 fan6 gung1 fo3 laa1
